from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
entries=[('707668.hopper-m-02','t01v2_flip60_fp204_retry1_accounting_01','diag_flip_sealed_fp204_retry1'),('707691.hopper-m-02','t01v2_flip60_fp203_r02_accounting_01','diag_flip_sealed_fp203_r02')]
table=['| Job | GPUs | Queue wait (minutes) | Measured allocation GPU-hours | Recorded charge rate |','|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|']

print('Copied measured PBS entries into the existing two funnel reports and STATUS.')
